Single source for the engine (places, pins, walks, rates, the city's life), the lore (tools/merge_lorebooks.py hanakaze) and the map tab (tools/gen_ui.py); the Avalon pattern. Pins hold places; x/y are percent positions on map/yozakura.webp (the owner's map; the pins follow its picture, so Thunder Gate Temple has its own pin halfway up Victors' Avenue). window: from the liner's landing at the Skyport to its boarding home, for the national four (Competition.Tier World) in the year Yozakura hosts. legs: [pinA, pinB, minutes on foot]; a fourth field 'tour' is the team carriage from the Thousand Lantern Inn, the only way to a match ground (no fare). in: minutes from a place to its pin's centre. locked: the Alpha's Residence, closed to every guest (hidden on the map). hidden: the Warrens, on the map only once visited. kc: a competition ground (the same field as Avalon's Kingdom grounds): 1 the Bamboo Sea (Phase 1, open on the days in grounds['1']), 2 Old Castle Shiroyama (Phase 2, grounds['2']); 1.97.4 narrows them to the days Eldrasil plays. out: outdoors (weather). rates: per hour in the city, in percent. schedule: [week, day, time, what] for <now>'s Today lines. climate: snowy winter (wet and at or below snow_at is snow).

places.name: Hanakaze Skyport
places.brief: red mooring towers along the bay, the liners
places.vibe: Red towers, white balloons, and a clerk bowing before every stamp.
places.desc: The hub of Yozakura's airship lines: red mooring towers in a row along the bay, liners coming and going all day, and clerks who bow before they stamp.

places.name: Red Tower Arcade
places.brief: the great companies' flagship counters, winter sweets
places.desc: A covered arcade beneath the mooring towers, where Yozakura's great service companies keep their flagship counters: the hotel chain behind The Hanabira at Sunreach, the airship lines, the bathhouse houses. Boxed winter sweets, folding umbrellas, lucky charms for the flight home.

places.name: The Challenge Crossing
places.brief: the five-way crossing where any fair challenge is fought
places.vibe: A bell, a thousand people moving at once, and someone always shouting a challenge.
places.desc: The great five-way crossing on Victors' Avenue, the main street from the castle hill, lined with snow-laden sakura and a stone lantern for every Alpha. When the bell rings, the crowd crosses in every direction at once; on the clerks' platform in the middle, anyone may challenge anyone to a fair contest, from duels to eating matches, and a Tournament Office clerk records the result. A Yozakuran never refuses.

places.name: The Eternal Sakura
places.brief: the giant sakura in bloom all year
places.vibe: Pink petals falling on white snow, and the whole crowd gone quiet.
places.desc: A giant sakura at the heart of the city, wider than a house and older than the throne, in full bloom all year round. In winter its pink petals fall onto the snow beneath it, and the whole city comes to stand under it at least once. Nobody knows why it never stops flowering; Yozakurans say it will bloom as long as Yozakura has an Alpha.

places.name: Snow Festival Park
places.brief: the snow festival, a sculpture of every team's ace
places.desc: The long park around the Eternal Sakura, given over this week to the snow festival: towering snow sculptures of past Alphas and champions, ice slides for children and students alike, and a sculpture of every competing team's ace, unveiled at the opening banquet.

places.name: The Golden Pavilion
places.brief: a gilded pavilion on a still pond
places.desc: A gilded pavilion on a still pond at the park's far end, its golden roof white with snow and doubled in the water: the most painted view in Yozakura.

places.name: Thunder Gate Temple
places.brief: the oldest temple, its great red gate and lantern
places.vibe: Incense, grilled rice crackers, and fortune slips fluttering on every branch.
places.desc: The city's oldest temple behind a great red gate hung with one enormous paper lantern, guarded by carved thunder and wind gods. Fortune slips tied to every branch, a five-storey pagoda in the courtyard, and the narrow approach street before it selling grilled rice crackers, sweet bean cakes and fox masks.

places.name: The Hall of Victors
places.brief: the Alpha's great hall, the banquets
places.vibe: Every Alpha's name carved in the pillars, the newest still bright.
places.desc: The Alpha's great hall on the castle hill, where the opening and closing banquets are held. The name of every Alpha is carved into its pillars, the newest still bright; the government's offices and the Tournament Office fill the wooden wings below it.

places.name: The Alpha's Residence
places.brief: closed to every guest
places.desc: Behind the Hall, closed to every guest. Whoever holds the throne lives here until someone takes it from them.

places.name: The Fox Gates
places.brief: thousands of red gates up the mountain path
places.vibe: A red tunnel through the snow, and a stone fox at every turn.
places.desc: A mountain path through thousands of red gates, one after another, climbing through the snow; stone foxes guard every turn, and Yozakurans leave offerings for luck before a fight.

places.name: The Cliff Temple
places.brief: a temple on stilts over a ravine, the best view
places.desc: A wooden temple built out over a ravine on great timber stilts, its veranda the city's best view: the bay, the rooftops white with snow, the pink crown of the Eternal Sakura, and Mount Hakuho on the horizon.

places.name: The Crowning Ring
places.brief: the stone ring where the Alpha is crowned; the Grand Final
places.vibe: Thirty thousand seats around a ring of bare stone.
places.desc: The arena where the Alpha is crowned by tournament: a stone ring under open sky, tiered galleries for thirty thousand, and great starglass scrying crystals that carry the final to every capital.

places.name: The Thousand Lantern Inn
places.brief: where every team lodges, one wing each
places.vibe: Paper screens, polished corridors, and six nations at breakfast within earshot.
places.desc: A vast wooden inn beside the Ring, of the same company that runs The Hanabira, where every team lodges, one wing each. Paper screens, polished corridors, staff who remember every guest's name, hot springs in a walled garden under snow-laden sakura, and a dining hall where six nations eat breakfast within earshot of each other.

places.name: The Hundred Alleys
places.brief: a hundred tiny stalls in lanes too narrow to pass
places.vibe: Broth simmered since dawn, charcoal smoke, and laughter spilling into the snow.
places.desc: A knot of lanes so narrow two people cannot pass, packed with a hundred tiny stalls that seat six at most: noodle broth simmered since dawn, skewers over charcoal, sake by the cup, smoke and laughter spilling into the snow. Every stall owner knows every regular.

places.name: The Glass Canal
places.brief: glass-blowing workshops, snow lanterns at night
places.desc: An old canal lined with stone warehouses turned into glass-blowing workshops and music-box shops, where visitors can blow their own glass; at night in winter, hundreds of candles in snow lanterns light the path along the water.

places.name: Forge Street
places.brief: the katana smiths
places.desc: The katana smiths' street: the ring of hammers from dawn, blades cooling in snow-fed troughs, and swords far more visitors admire than can afford. The smiths test a buyer's hand before they sell, and register every blade they make.

places.name: The Mask Theatre
places.brief: Yozakura's great stage
places.desc: Yozakura's great stage: painted faces, roaring actors, revolving sets and a crowd that shouts the famous lines along with the cast.

places.name: The Warrens
places.desc: Hanakaze's underbelly, a warren of old flood tunnels, sake cellars and smugglers' passages beneath the Hundred Alleys, older than the castle on the hill. Its people call themselves ronin, the masterless, a joke at the Alpha's expense. A black market (stolen goods, unregistered blades from smiths who will not sign them, forged Tournament Office records, contraband components), gambling dens that take bets on every challenge in the city, the Cellar Ring where fights are held that are anything but fair (no rules, no clerks, bets in cash), and brokers who sell information to anyone. Lantern-lit, crowded and polite in its own way: ronin do not rob guests who bow properly, and they never forget a face that brings the Alpha's Watch. Students are forbidden to go there.

places.name: Hell Valley Springs
places.brief: a steaming volcanic valley and its bathhouses
places.vibe: Sulphur steam, hissing vents, and grim old men in the hottest pool.
places.desc: A steaming volcanic valley on the city's edge, sulphur vents hissing between the rocks and carved demon statues on the path, with bathhouses below fed by its waters. Yozakurans settle arguments here, in silence, by who leaves the hottest pool last.

places.name: The Bamboo Sea
places.brief: Phase 1's forest, by team carriage
places.desc: A vast bamboo forest beyond the city, its stalks bowed under snow, ringed for the competition by a barrier that closes in all day.

places.name: Old Castle Shiroyama
places.brief: Phase 2's ruined castle, by team carriage
places.desc: A ruined white hill castle from the age of warring lords, stone walls and gates still standing; its two ward stones are the Siege's targets.
